input.commit_mapping: Published data commit and raw feed SHA provided by owner; all local bytes verified against exact SHA. No semantic Git command executed.
input.fang_input: Read with git show at fixed local data commit; no fetch or mutation.
input.limits: Existing evidence verification, not new execution, central import or complete scientific acceptance. Plans and traces not separately revalidated here.

fang_k4.posthoc_limit: A per-case mixed envelope only; not a runnable selector or one algorithm score.
fang_k4.wall_comparison_limit: Our Apple M5 Pro/macOS and Fang AMD Ryzen 5 5600H/Windows were different machines and loads; no causal speed claim.

definitions.mean: 1/100 sum_i official_A_singlecore_M_i / solver_P2_M_i,k; not ratio of totals or algorithm k1 denominator.
definitions.success: Existing E0-backed successful artifact; distinct from competitive quality or optimality.
definitions.whole500_wall: Sum of 500 per-cell solver walls is aggregate work, not elapsed throughput or exclusive latency.
